business_overview.one_sentence: The group holds some investment properties for rental income and provides commercial operational services and residential property management services in Mainland China.

segments.business_substance: Market positioning, tenant sourcing, mall operation and management, and commercial property leasing services.
segments.source: Annual Report 2025, Management Discussion and Analysis, revenue by business segment

segments.business_substance: Pre-sale management, delivered property management, and value-added services.
segments.source: Annual Report 2025, Management Discussion and Analysis, revenue by business segment

business_overview.revenue_model: Service fees from commercial operation and residential property management plus leasing income from commercial property leasing services.
business_notes: Commercial operational services accounted for 80.5% of 2025 revenue; residential property management services accounted for 19.5%.
The group is controlled by Powerlong Real Estate related parties, and related-party receivables are material.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Operating cash flow has exceeded reported parent profit in 2024-2025, but profits are affected by real estate cycle exposure, related-party receivables and large expected credit losses. Lease cash payments are included in financing cash flow and need to be considered when judging distributable cash.

evidence.source: Annual Report 2025, Management Discussion and Analysis
evidence.note: During 2025, the group had no bank loans and other borrowings.

gaps: The annual report does not split group cash by each PRC operating subsidiary, listed-company offshore entity and operational cash account.
The report identifies restricted cash but does not provide a detailed use restriction schedule for the RMB40.692 million restricted balance.
Maintenance capex is not separately disclosed from growth capex; the analysis uses recent cash purchases of property/equipment and intangibles as a conservative maintenance proxy.
Working capital reinvestment cannot be separated cleanly from collection cycle changes because related-party and third-party receivables carry large expected credit loss allowances.
